purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel geometry for Mavelikkara, India; failed access, CAPTCHA, and source-search outcomes are not treated as evidence that no cadastre exists.
name: Mavelikkara

queries.query: Mavelikkara Kerala official cadastral parcel map GIS land records survey map
queries.result: Found official Kerala Bhu-Naksha/eMaps cadastral mapping viewer, Ente Bhoomi digital land-survey portal, Kerala Revenue Mavelikkara Village Office, and official digital-survey village lists. The inspected public paths did not yield an anonymous parcel-polygon response.

queries.query: മാവേലിക്കര കേരള ഔദ്യോഗിക കഡസ്ട്രൽ പാർസൽ മാപ്പ് ജിഐഎസ് ഭൂ രേഖകൾ സർവേ മാപ്പ്
queries.result: Found the official Malayalam Ente Bhoomi land-survey portal and Kerala government land-record pages. The portal identifies Mavelikkara village and survey workflow, but parcel lookup is protected by CAPTCHA and no geometry response was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Kerala Survey, Revenue and Registration departments describe eMaps/Bhu-Naksha as an integrated cadastral mapping system intended to provide digital sketches of individual parcels; the current HTTPS host presented an expired TLS certificate during direct inspection, so no certificate exception or request was made.

Official Ente Bhoomi search page is a public land-survey lookup interface. Its current HTML and JavaScript define the anonymous district/taluk/village/block cascade and require a CAPTCHA on parcel search.

Kerala Revenue Department first-party page identifies Mavelikkara Village Office in Alappuzha district and Mavelikkara taluk. This is local registry/revenue custodian evidence, not a vector parcel endpoint.
Official digital-survey village list includes Mavelikkara taluk villages, including Mavelikkara, and records the survey programme scope.

requests.method: GET page and current JavaScript/configuration inspection
requests.outcome: Anonymous page loaded. Current scripts use /portal/district/taluk/gid, /portal/district/village/gid, /portal/survey/blocks, and POST /portal/survey/search/. The form includes CAPTCHA; no login or private credential was used.
Returned Alappuzha taluks, including Mavelikkara (native name മാവേലിക്കര; taluk code 06).
Returned Mavelikkara taluk villages, including Mavelikkara (native name മാവേലിക്കര; village code 04).
Returned a bounded list of block codes for Mavelikkara village. This is lookup metadata only; it contains no geometry or safe parcel identity.
Held because the public form requires a CAPTCHA and a survey number/subdivision input. CAPTCHA solving or bypass was not attempted.
TLS verification failed because the host certificate is expired. No narrow certificate exception was authorized, so no viewer JavaScript/configuration or API request was fetched from this host.

registryBasis: Kerala Revenue's Mavelikkara Village Office page and Kerala Survey/Revenue first-party cadastral and digital-survey portals evidence a local revenue/survey custodian and public procedures. No public city-bounded parcel polygon endpoint was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Mavelikkara Village Office and Kerala state cadastral/digital-survey services reached through first-party sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Administrative cascade metadata only; no parcel geometry or native parcel identity returned.

remainingUncertainty: Mavelikkara is evidenced in Kerala's cadastral and digital-survey systems, but the current Bhu-Naksha endpoint could not be inspected due to expired TLS, and Ente Bhoomi parcel search requires CAPTCHA plus parcel inputs. No exact-point hit, map extent miss, or unusable UI is treated as citywide absence. No sample GeoJSON was retained.
